يتهاديان (form VI)
# يَتَهَادَيَانِ (yatahādayāni) /ja.ta.haː.da.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of تَهَادَى (tahādā)
# يُتَهَادَيَانِ (yutahādayāni) /ju.ta.haː.da.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of تَهَادَى (tahādā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
